questions: Should the function handle DataFrames where the target column contains non-numeric values (e.g., strings, NaNs)?
Is the score to be returned the R-squared (coefficient of determination) as from LinearRegression.score(), or some other metric?
Should the function drop rows with missing values in any column (including features) before fitting?
If the DataFrame has only one column (the target), should it raise an error or handle it somehow?
Should the function ensure that the target column is excluded from features even if it appears multiple times or with same name?
Is the order of columns in X important (e.g., alphabetical, original order), or can it be any order as long as target is excluded?
Should the function include an intercept by default (as sklearn does), or should it fit without intercept?
If the DataFrame has an index, should it be used as a feature or ignored?
